spells.targets: Allocate exactly three numbered rays 1, 2, 3 at cast commitment among one to three distinct perceived creatures or independently legal objects within 30 feet and line of effect. Multiple rays may share a recipient; lock allocations and resolution order.
spells.resolution: After the cast survives its interruption window, resolve rays 1→2→3. Each makes its own ranged spell attack against its still-legal assigned target. A hit deals independently rolled 2d6 fire; a miss does nothing. A target that becomes illegal before its ray resolves loses that allocation, with no retargeting or recovered last-location attack.
spells.effect: Each ray is its own attack and damage event, with its own critical dice, defenses and actual hit/damage callbacks. Do not share one damage roll among rays or combine them into one packet. Ordinary Shield contributes its actual applicable AC protection; Magic Missile Storm’s named damage-prevention bridge does not apply.
spells.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
spells.limitations: No Burning, chaining, physical ammunition, recoverable ray or free target replacement. A directly selected object must be perceived, within range and line of effect, and independently legal: unattended, held by the caster, or deliberately offered by a willing holder. This gives no general permission to target hostile worn/carried inventory. Use actual object AC, durability and defenses; the spell does not automatically destroy an object. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-2 placements have base 3 RP; actual source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.
